generatedProse.concept-context: In sport and exercise science, this shows up after a practical, a coaching session or a data report. You look back with a structure, work out why the session or analysis fell short and what your own part was, and set one concrete change for next time. The three moves run together on the one experience.
generatedProse.worked-example: Two sport science students get the same feedback on a training-analysis report. One notes it was thin and resolves to be more thorough. The other runs the whole practice: a structured look back, a real reason (they read the data to fit what they expected), and one action, to set their question before opening the figures. The second student's next analysis is sharper, because the three moves worked as one.
generatedProse.summary: In sport and exercise science, the practice is most useful run whole. After each practical, session or report, you look back with a structure, reach an honest reason, and set one concrete action. Running all three together across your modules is what strengthens your sport science work.

check.body: A student sets out what happened on a presentation, works out why it overran and what their own part was, and plans one timed run-through for next time. What does this show?

items.text: Their next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following programme improved.
Nothing; feedback comes at the end, so it cannot affect anything that follows.
Only the mark on the first programme, which cannot now change.
The deadline for the next programme.

feedback.correct: That's right. Using the feedback fed back into the next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following programme improved: that is the cycle working.
feedback.incorrectNotFinal: Not quite. Think about what the student changed before the next programme, not the old mark or the deadline.
feedback.incorrectFinal: Using the feedback fed back into the student's next round of learning and preparation, which is why the next programme improved. The old mark cannot change and the deadline is not part of the cycle; feedback is not the end, it feeds the next turn.

_items.text: That the three moves are working together as one practice: a structured look back, a real reason, and a concrete action.
_items.feedback: Yes. Structure, depth and action are all in play on the one experience.

_items.text: That the student used only one of the three moves and skipped the rest.
_items.feedback: Look again: the structure, the reason and the action are all there.

_items.text: That reflecting critically cannot be joined to setting an action.
_items.feedback: The example joins them: the reason leads straight to the action.

_items.text: That reflection belongs only after a presentation has gone wrong.
_items.feedback: The practice fits any experience, not only ones that go wrong.
